title: Add a way to insert (add) Bikes, Motorcycles, and Supercars into the catalog

requirements.text: Add a backend update method that allows creating a new vehicle with an automatically assigned unique ID (so users do not need to manually choose the `id` when inserting bikes, motorcycles, or supercars).

quotes: how do i insert cars bike and motorcycle

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a new update method that accepts: vehicleType, make, specs, price, images and returns the created Vehicle (including its assigned id).
The assigned id is unique within the canister’s current catalog and does not overwrite an existing vehicle.
The method supports the existing frontend vehicleType values used by routing/category pages (Bike, Motorcycle, Car).

requirements.text: Create a new frontend page that provides a simple “Add Vehicle” form to insert vehicles into the catalog (Bike, Motorcycle, Car) by calling the backend create/add method.

quotes: how do i insert cars bike and motorcycle

acceptanceCriteria: A new route exists for an Add Vehicle page and it renders inside the existing AppLayout.
The page includes inputs for all required vehicle fields: vehicleType (select), make, model, year, engine, power, topSpeed, acceleration, weight, price, and images (one or more image URLs).
Submitting the form successfully creates a vehicle in the backend and shows a clear success message in English.
After successful creation, the user can navigate to the created vehicle’s detail page or see it appear in the relevant category listing after refresh/query invalidation.
Validation prevents empty required fields and shows actionable error messages in English (e.g., invalid year/power/price, missing model).

requirements.text: Add an optional “Seed sample vehicles” action in the UI that inserts a small curated starter set across Bike, Motorcycle, and Car categories for quick testing.

quotes: how do i insert cars bike and motorcycle

acceptanceCriteria: The Add Vehicle page includes a button to seed sample vehicles.
Seeding adds at least 1 vehicle per category (Bike, Motorcycle, Car) using the same backend add/create method as the form.
After seeding, Home Featured and Category pages can display the newly inserted vehicles without requiring a redeploy.

requirements.text: Ensure React Query vehicle lists refresh appropriately after adding or seeding vehicles so users immediately see newly inserted items on Home/Category pages.

quotes: how do i insert cars bike and motorcycle

acceptanceCriteria: After a successful add/seed operation, queries for vehicles are invalidated/refetched so HomePage featured vehicles and CategoryPage listings can reflect changes.
No changes are made to the immutable hook files listed in the system constraints.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor; implement new logic in backend/main.mo.

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing third-party authentication/roles beyond Internet Identity.
Adding an external database or any non-IC persistence layer.
Bulk import from CSV or external APIs.
